name: Film Returns Report
purpose: Calculates each film's box office return on its budget, by distributor and release year

inputs.production_budget: Money spent making the film, in dollars
inputs.worldwide_box_office: Ticket money the film made around the world, in dollars
inputs.us_box_office: Ticket money the film made in the United States, in dollars
inputs.distributor: Company that released the film in cinemas
inputs.runtime_minutes: Length of the film, in minutes
inputs.critic_score: Percentage of critics who gave the film a good review
inputs.lead_actor: Name of the film's lead actor
